_note: What a building GAINS at each art tier. Tiers are l1, l4 and l8: the renderer draws the highest tier at or below the district's level, so three drawings dress all ten levels (mapRenderer.ts). Each block is appended to the base scene block by make-prompt.mjs, and the building's own l1 sprite is attached to the message so the model grows THAT building instead of inventing another.

Townhall.4: a second storey on the hall with a row of arched windows; the turret raised taller with a pennant on its finial and a SECOND smaller turret at the other end; the low wall grown to shoulder height with simple crenellations and a stone gatehouse arch over the path; a second blue-and-gold banner
Townhall.8: a small castle: two tall towers with steep blue conical roofs and gold finials, a proper gatehouse with a raised portcullis, a crenellated curtain wall with a walkway and corner turrets, four blue-and-gold banners, and the earth path replaced by pale flagstones

Housing.4: a second storey in timber framing that overhangs the ground floor, two dormer windows set into the blue roof, a second chimney, and a small covered porch on carved posts
Housing.8: a small manor: three storeys, a dressed-stone ground floor under decorative timber framing above, a projecting bay window, two tall banded chimneys, and a low railing along the front

Farm.4: the barn taller, with a hayloft door and a pulley beam above the main doors, a lean-to shelter holding the cart, a second hay stack, and a squat stone silo at one end
Farm.8: a farmstead: a tall stone-and-timber barn with a roof cupola and a weathervane, a full round silo capped with a blue conical roof, and a covered bay with a laden cart

Sawmill.4: the open shed given walls and a second working bay, a WATER WHEEL on one side turning the blade through a shaft, a taller stack of logs, and a sharpening bench
Sawmill.8: a full mill: two storeys under a blue roof, a large water wheel with a millrace, a timber crane hoisting a log, and finished planks stacked deep under a canopy

Quarry.4: the rock face cut deeper into two terraces, a larger derrick with a winch drum, a frame saw set over a block, and dressed blocks stacked in rows
Quarry.8: a quarry works: a tall timber gantry crane running on rails above the cut, a stone-cutting shed with a blue roof, a loaded wagon on the ramp, and blocks stacked in tiers

Docks.4: the pier widened with a second mooring, the hut given a first floor, a small crane on the quay, a second boat, and more crates and barrels along the boards
Docks.8: a harbour front: a dressed-stone quay edge, a tall timber crane with a hook and rope, a two-storey harbour house under a blue roof with a small lantern tower, three moored boats, and nets and casks

Sanctum.4: the tower taller by a storey with a second tier of arched windows, a RING of small crystals orbiting the main one, and a low circle of stones at its foot carved with violet-glowing runes
Sanctum.8: a slender spire of three tiers with buttresses, a large faceted crystal wreathed in violet light with motes circling it, and bands of glowing runes climbing the stone

Barracks.4: a second storey pierced with arrow slits, one corner tower under a blue roof, a longer weapon rack, a training post, and a second banner
Barracks.8: a fortified keep: a crenellated parapet with a walkway, two corner towers with blue conical roofs and gold finials, a studded gate, four banners, and shields stacked by the door

SpearHall.4: the open hall closed at the back with a stone wall and given a first floor with a shuttered window, a longer spear rack, a second training dummy, and a weapon stand
SpearHall.8: a long training hall: stone below and timber above under a blue-tiled roof with a roof louvre, a covered colonnade along the front, racks of spears on both sides, and a banner over the entrance

ShootingGrounds.4: the shelter given a second bay and a proper tiled roof, a SECOND target butt further down the range, a rack of bows and a barrel of arrows
ShootingGrounds.8: a proper range: a long covered shooting line on stone footings, three target butts at increasing distances, a raised platform with a timber rail, and banners spaced along the line

Stables.4: four split stable doors instead of two, a hayloft above with a pulley beam, a longer paddock fence, and a saddle rack beside the trough
Stables.8: a courtyard stable: an L-shaped block under a blue-tiled roof with a weathervane on the gable, six stable doors, a covered mounting block, and a fenced paddock corner

Infirmary.4: a second storey with shuttered windows, the awning lengthened onto carved posts, a drying rack hung with herbs, more terracotta pots, and a carved stone basin with running water
Infirmary.8: a small hospice: two wings under blue roofs, a covered cloister walk with stone arches, a herb garden in raised stone beds, and a bell hanging over the door

Carpenter.4: the workshop enclosed and given a first floor, a treadle lathe with a half-turned leg, a longer bench with tools on a board, and a larger plank stack under a canopy
Carpenter.8: a joinery: two storeys with a hoist beam and pulley in the gable, a wide open front with two work benches, finished chairs and a chest set out, and deep plank racks

MasonsYard.4: the shed given a first floor, a treadle-driven stone saw on a timber frame, a hoist tripod with a block slung from it, and blocks stacked in two tiers
MasonsYard.8: a mason's works: a stone building under a blue roof with a tall hoist gantry, a rotating crane arm, a carving bench holding a half-finished column capital, and dressed blocks in tiers

Smelter.4: a SECOND furnace beside the first, a taller banded chimney, a larger bellows on a timber frame, a quenching trough, and ingots in stacks
Smelter.8: a foundry: a tall stone furnace stack banded in iron with a hood, TWO working mouths glowing orange, a mechanical bellows driven by a wheel, a crucible on a swing arm, and ingots in neat tiers

RuneCarver.4: the shed enclosed and given a first floor, TWO standing stones instead of one, a workbench laid with chisels, and a low ring of small runestones glowing violet
RuneCarver.8: a rune hall: a stone building under a blue roof, a tall carved menhir at its side glowing violet with motes rising from it, an arch built of runestones, and a workbench under a canopy
